prompt_bank.prompt: You are an expert e-commerce SEO copywriter for {marketplace}. Product: {product}. Seller note: {description}. Language: {lang}. Return JSON {title(80ch), description(rich bullets+emoji), tags[14]}.
Photorealistic studio product shot of {product} on clean white background, softbox lighting, 8k, e-commerce marketplace style. Negative: blurry, hands, text.
Write 800-word SEO article in {lang} about selling {niche} on Etsy/Mercado Livre. H2 structure, actionable tips, 14 long-tail tags at end.
Create a Pinterest pin title + description for topic '{niche}'. Catchy, save-worthy, include emoji and link CTA.
Write a 60-word cold email to an Etsy/Mercado Livre seller offering LISTO AI to 10x their listing SEO. No spam, value-first.
Reply to customer in {lang}, friendly, concise. Question: {question}. If billing, give link to planos. If bug, log and reassure fix in 24h.
Given MRR {mrr} and churn {churn}, suggest plan price adjustments to maximize LTV. Output JSON {pro,business,reason}.
Compare landing variant A vs B conversion. Recommend winner and next test. Output JSON {winner,confidence,next_test}.
